header: Record types are listed as blocks: a record's properties, and with '->' the nodes they lead to (follow them for nested values). Codes are nodes typed with their terminology class (prefixes: atc:, chop:, dcm:, eco:, edam:, efo:, emdn:, genepio:, geno:, hgnc:, icd-10-gm:, icd-o-3:, loinc:, obi:, oncotree:, ordo:, snomed:, so:, sphn-atc:, sphn-dcm:, sphn-deprecated:, sphn-eco:, sphn-edam:, sphn-efo:, sphn-genepio:, sphn-geno:, sphn-hgnc:, sphn-icd-o-3:, sphn-individual:, sphn-loinc:, sphn-obi:, sphn-ordo:, sphn-so:, ucum:, constraints:). 'code under X': the code's class is below X; X is only the root of the allowed codes, never a value, so do not filter on X: filter on a class below it, or group by the class. 'one of' lists the allowed values; 'kinds' the subclasses of a node's class. A code node belongs to a single record: to group, compare, count or return codes, bind the class (?code rdf:type ?class, without the inference option) and use ?class, never ?code or STR(?code).

docs.sphn:AccessDevice: Access Device product intended for medical use to gain access to the body, such as cannula, tube, catheter or drainage

docs.sphn:AntimicrobialSusceptibilityLabTestE: Antimicrobial Susceptibility Lab Test Event occurrence in which one or multiple laboratory tests are performed on an isolate at a given time for determining antimicrobial susceptibility
docs.sphn:AntimicrobialSusceptibilityResult: Antimicrobial Susceptibility Result result of an antimicrobial susceptibility lab analysis
